title: The sacks by the ladder
subtitle: Nyai Ratri has buyers waiting for the Tuban Moon's rice at her yard in Upeh. The unloading crew finds four sacks set apart by the ladder. Ratri asks you to look before the grain goes into the yard bins.

evidence.label: 01  Manifest
evidence.title: The Tuban Moon’s declaration
evidence.text:
Tuban Moon — jong from Tuban, Java
Shore broker: Nyai Ratri of Upeh

Twenty sacks of sound milled rice for the food market. All twenty entered as one lot.

evidence.label: 02  Deck tally
evidence.title: Four sacks apart
evidence.text: Sixteen sacks stand ready by the sling. Four sit on a mat by the ladder. The same merchant mark appears on every sack. One by the ladder has a ragged outer seam, but it is as full as the others. The straw mat and sackcloth are dry.

evidence.label: 03  Testimony
evidence.title: Why the four were moved
evidence.text:
Store hand
I filled out the entry before we moved the sacks. Then a porter saw something crawl out of a seam. I put the four sacks from that corner on a mat and sent for Ratri. I haven't opened them.

Nyai Ratri
I can sell sixteen and tell four buyers to wait. I can't have the whole load tipped into one bin and spend tomorrow trying to take it apart.

evidence.label: 04  Open sacks
evidence.title: Grain from the bottom of each sack
evidence.text: You open the sacks and draw a scoop from deep in each, emptying each scoop separately onto the mat. The sixteen at the sling pour freely and leave no insects in their samples. From every sack by the ladder, small dark beetles crawl out of the grain onto the pale mat. Many of the kernels in those four scoops have been hollowed out. The sack with the ragged seam is no worse than the other three.

rulings.label: Major Fraud — hold the suspect cargo
Story Event — hold the ship and notify the court

reasons.label: The sacks are full and dry; the insects have not eaten the rice.
Only the sack with the torn seam needs to be taken out of the sale.
Four sacks contain beetles and hollow kernels; only the other sixteen can go to the food market.
The same mark on all twenty sacks means the whole lot is spoiled.

feedback_by_method.marks: All twenty sacks have the same mark, but that does not make their contents equally sound.
feedback_by_method.measurements: Twenty full sacks came aboard. A full sack can still hold grain too badly eaten to sell as sound.
feedback_by_method.testimony: The store hand saw one beetle and set four sacks apart. Open them and check the grain to find out how far the damage goes.
feedback_by_method.manifest: The entry still says all twenty are sound. It was made before the store hand spotted anything moving in the seams.

hidden_truth.success: In the temenggung's name, you amend the entry to sixteen sacks for the food market and direct the crew to keep the four infested sacks apart ashore. Ratri calls the buyers to the sling instead of the bins. No additional charge falls on the sound grain.
hidden_truth.clear: You leave all twenty sacks on the food-market entry. Ratri draws the four back at her yard, but the buyers still arrive expecting a full lot.
hidden_truth.unsupported: The evidence you filed does not support changing the entry in the temenggung's name. The sacks must be checked separately: one bad seam does not tell you what is in any of them.
hidden_truth.hold: You hold the Tuban Moon for the court. By the time a court runner comes to hear about four sacks of spoiled rice, sixteen sound sacks have missed the market too.

truth.summary: Part of a correctly counted food lot is infested. The crew isolated the suspected sacks after the entry was made and called the broker instead of passing them off as sound.
deduction: All twenty sacks were entered as sound before the crew noticed insects. Neither the dry cloth nor the torn outer seam measures spoilage.
Grain samples reveal damage deep inside all four separated sacks, not just a stray insect on the cloth. The other sixteen show no such evidence.

history_notes.note: Melaka depended on imported rice; Tuban was a documented Javanese source. See docs/research/commodities.md §3.2 and docs/research/prices.md §4.2. Provisions paid assessed presents rather than normal western entry dues (docs/research/port-official.md §5.1).
The written manifest, sack marks, sack counts as sale units, sampling procedure and the spoilage incident are gameplay inventions, not a documented Melaka inspection or grain-pest record.
